notes: Registry spans are used because the abstracts do not report atrial fibrillation results. Served counts and time frame match. The registry labels the reported effect Rate Ratio; RR here preserves that label and does not imply a separately reported risk ratio. Aspirin versus placebo was independently randomized in the factorial design.
